name: The Shamed Lieutenant
summary: A Stormwind guard asks you to check on Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore. His reassignment is meant to teach him a lesson, but the guard hopes he can still succeed.

sections.title: A Check-In
sections.body: You've safely delivered the statuette. Now your contact asks you to speak with Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, a city guard sent to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. Farren's father was a friend of the guard, who believes he could benefit from help. If you are passing through, a boat bound for Southshore leaves from Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Who am I being asked to speak with?
faq.answer: You are being asked to speak with Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, a city guard sent to Southshore.
Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is in Southshore, in Hillsbrad Foothills.
The guard says Farren could use the lesson, but gives no further reason for his reassignment.

faq.q: How does the guard know Farren?
faq.answer: Farren's father was a friend of the guard who asks you to check on him.

faq.q: How can I get to Southshore?
faq.answer: A boat from Menethil Harbor can take you to Southshore.

faq.q: Has anyone checked on Farren before?
faq.answer: Farren says another Stormwind guard came to check on him the previous month.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you are asked to check on a Stormwind city guard serving in Southshore.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Shamed Lieutenant
